entities.name: Jenzo
entities.description: Young human mechanic from Far Corner on Kamigawa who studied at the Imperial Academy and lost a hand to the Mukotai Reckoners.

entities.name: Far Corner
entities.description: Town on Kamigawa defended against the Mukotai.

entities.name: Mukotai Reckoners
entities.description: Gang that maimed Jenzo and attacked Far Corner.

entities.name: Ayari
entities.description: Saved Jenzo from a Mukotai mech and fled with him.

entities.name: Kaima
entities.description: Vengeful kami whose emergence forced Jenzo and Ayari to flee.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the events took place.

events.summary: The Mukotai maimed Jenzo and nailed his severed hand to the town's gate.
events.quote: the Mukotai maimed Jenzo, nailing his severed hand to the town's gate

events.summary: Jenzo warned Far Corner of the imminent attack.
events.quote: Jenzo warned the community of the imminent danger

events.summary: Ayari saved Jenzo from a Mukotai mech as he tried to arm a disruptor.
events.quote: He was saved by Ayari and continued to assist in the town's defense.

events.summary: Kaima emerged and forced Jenzo and Ayari to flee their home.
events.quote: forcing Jenzo and Ayari to flee their home or be killed

relations.quote: He was saved by Ayari and continued to assist in the town's defense.
